reference_sql:
SELECT pr.promo_code, p.product_name
FROM promotion_products pp
JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promo_id = pp.promo_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.product_id
WHERE pr.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
alternatives: SELECT pr.promo_code, p.product_name FROM promotion_products pp, promotions pr, products p WHERE p.product_id = pp.product_id AND pr.promo_id = pp.promo_id AND pr.start_date >= DATE '2025-03-01' AND pr.start_date < DATE '2025-04-01'

SELECT pr.promo_code, p.product_name FROM promotions pr JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = pr.promo_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.product_id WHERE pr.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
